fusions.name: Shaken-Off Spray
fusions.desc: Shakes water off your wings in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 10 damage to everything in it and leaving it [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Slick of Calm
fusions.desc: Flicks a preen-oiled feather into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave it [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Water Off the Back
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

fusions.name: Unruffled Glide

riders.text: you move 10% faster over it than over ground
and your dodge chance is 8% higher while you are on it
and your mana recovers 25% faster while you are on it

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground.
